Chapter 1: Pitch
1.1 Notes And The Staff
Notes are written on a five-line staff and named with the letters A through G.1.2 Accidentals
Accidentals such as sharps and flats raise or lower a note by a half step.Chapter 2: Rhythm
2.1 Note Durations
Note durations like whole, half, and quarter notes define how long a pitch sounds.2.2 Time Signatures
A time signature shows how many beats are in each measure and which note gets the beat.
